fields.name: S02_distxt_GCAmount
fields.fieldText:
1. Add your Allocations. DO NOT reuse Funds on this screen.
  2. Scroll down and click CALCULATE as needed to refresh your progress toward the "Total Commitment Amount" below.
  3. Make sure to CALCULATE at least once before confirming the toggles at the bottom of this window.

Total Commitment Amount: ${!recordId.ExpectedTotalCmtAmount}

Total Funds Allocated: {!fml_cur_TotalFundsAllocated}

Total Funds Remaining: {!fml_cur_FundsRemaining}

fields.name: S02_distxt_Toggle2Instructions

value.stringValue: Do you need to create another Restriction?

fields.name: S02_distxt_Toggle3Instructions
fields.fieldText:
Confirm TOGGLE, and click NEXT to create another Restriction.


You will then be able to add its Yearly Allocations.

fields.name: S03_Success
fields.fieldText: Your Restriction(s) and Yearly Allocation(s) have been created for this Gift Commitment. Please Click Finish to exit. Then, use the Edit Restrictions button at the top of this page to make updates to the Restrictions or Yearly Allocations as needed.
